
WORKFLOW-AUTOMATION
Workflow automation utilities for work units (record iterations, auto-advance state, validate spec alignment)

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command for workflow automation and metrics tracking. Essential for AI agents to track progress, measure efficiency (iterations), auto-advance work unit states after successful events, and validate alignment between work units and Gherkin specs.

PREREQUISITES
  • spec/work-units.json exists with work units
  • Work unit is in appropriate state for action

USAGE
  fspec workflow-automation <action> [work-unit-id] [options]

Actions:
  record-iteration     - Increment iteration counter for work unit
  auto-advance         - Auto-advance state after event (tests-pass, validation-pass, specs-complete)
  validate-alignment   - Check if work unit has corresponding Gherkin scenarios

ARGUMENTS
  <action> (required)
    Action to perform: record-iteration, auto-advance, validate-alignment
  <work-unit-id> (required)
    Work unit ID (required for all actions)

OPTIONS
  --event <event>
    Event triggering state change: tests-pass, validation-pass, specs-complete (used with auto-advance)
  --from-state <state>
    Current state before transition (used with auto-advance for safety check)

COMMON PATTERNS
  • TDD Cycle Tracking
    Example: # Start testing phase
fspec update-work-unit-status AUTH-001 testing

# Red: write failing test
<test-command>  # Tests fail
fspec workflow-automation record-iteration AUTH-001

# Green: implement code
<test-command>  # Tests pass
fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event tests-pass --from-state testing

# Now in implementing state, ready for next feature
    undefined

  • ACDD State Automation
    Example: # Specifying → Testing (after specs complete)
fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event specs-complete --from-state specifying

# Testing → Implementing (after tests pass)
fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event tests-pass --from-state testing

# Validating → Done (after validation passes)
fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event validation-pass --from-state validating
    undefined

  • Spec Alignment Validation
    Example: # After creating feature files, validate alignment
fspec workflow-automation validate-alignment AUTH-001

# If not aligned, add @AUTH-001 tag to scenarios
fspec add-scenario user-authentication "Login flow" --tags @AUTH-001

# Re-validate
fspec workflow-automation validate-alignment AUTH-001
    undefined


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  1. Start work: fspec update-work-unit-status <id> testing → 2. Write tests (red) → 3. Record iteration: fspec workflow-automation record-iteration <id> → 4. Implement (green) → 5. Tests pass → 6. Auto-advance: fspec workflow-automation auto-advance <id> --event tests-pass --from-state testing → 7. Validate alignment: fspec workflow-automation validate-alignment <id>

EXAMPLES
  1. Increment iteration counter (tracks red→green cycles)
  $ fspec workflow-automation record-iteration AUTH-001
  ✓ Recorded iteration for AUTH-001
  Total iterations: 3

  2. Auto-advance from testing → implementing after tests pass
  $ fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event tests-pass --from-state testing
  ✓ Advanced AUTH-001 from testing → implementing
  Event: tests-pass
  Updated: 2025-01-15T10:30:00Z

  3. Auto-advance from validating → done after validation passes
  $ fspec workflow-automation auto-advance AUTH-001 --event validation-pass --from-state validating
  ✓ Advanced AUTH-001 from validating → done
  Event: validation-pass

  4. Check if work unit has corresponding Gherkin scenarios
  $ fspec workflow-automation validate-alignment AUTH-001
  ✓ Work unit AUTH-001 is aligned with specifications
  Scenarios found: 5
  Features:
    - spec/features/user-authentication.feature
    - spec/features/session-management.feature

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Error: Work unit does not exist
    Fix: Verify work unit ID. Run: fspec list-work-units

  ✗ Error: Invalid transition: tests-pass from implementing
    Fix: tests-pass event only valid from "testing" state. Check current state with: fspec show-work-unit <id>

  ✗ Error: Work unit is in state "implementing", expected "testing"
    Fix: State mismatch. Verify current state before auto-advance. Use --from-state to ensure safety.

  ✗ Error: No scenarios found for work unit AUTH-001
    Fix: Work unit has no @AUTH-001 tagged scenarios. Add tag to scenarios or create feature file.

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec update-work-unit-status
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec create-story
  fspec create-bug
  fspec create-task
  fspec list-features
  fspec add-scenario

NOTES
  • Metrics tracked:
  •   - iterations: Number of red→green cycles (TDD iterations)
  • State transitions (auto-advance):
  •   - specs-complete: specifying → testing
  •   - tests-pass: testing → implementing
  •   - validation-pass: validating → done
  • Auto-advance safety:
  •   - Requires --from-state to verify current state before transition
  •   - Prevents invalid state transitions
  •   - Updates stateHistory with timestamp
  • Spec alignment:
  •   - Searches for @WORK-UNIT-ID tags in feature files
  •   - Returns count of matching scenarios and feature files
  •   - Essential for reverse ACDD to track specification coverage
  • Iteration tracking:
  •   - Increments on each red→green cycle
  •   - Useful metric for complexity/difficulty assessment
  •   - High iteration count may indicate unclear requirements
